risk_summary: The disclosure is materially negative, citing a 17.8% revenue decline, a $125.7 million net loss, impairment charges, deferred-tax valuation allowances, and suppressed client demand. Liquidity is quantified at $141.1 million, but operating performance and labor-market exposure indicate elevated downside risk. Management provides useful segment and sensitivity data, although forward-looking recovery language is somewhat generic.
